tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the models this account can generate with, grouped by what they make (3D, image, …): each with its id, the scenes (input modes such as text-to-3d or image-to-3d) it supports, and the credits it costs at default options. Call this first to choose a model id, then estimate_cost for an exact price

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Price a generation before starting it: the credits this model would charge for these options, and whether the current balance covers it. Uses the same validation and price calculation as generate_3d and generate, so for a valid request the figure is exactly what is charged. Omit scene to price every

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the credits this account can spend now (and how many of them come from the subscription or are permanent), the plan name when there is one, and — when you are connected with an API key that has a monthly credit limit — that limit, what the key has used this month, and when it resets. Read-only.

tools.name: generate_3d
tools.description: Start a 3D generation and return its job id at once. mode picks the input: text (prompt), image (options with the image URL), multiview (several view images), sketch, or model (edit an existing 3D model). Take the model id and its option names from list_models, and check the price with estimate_cost

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Start an async AI generation of any media type and return its job id. The input shape depends on the model (see list_models); for 3D prefer generate_3d. To run an image preset (list_models returns them: figurine, style, pose, convert), send mediaType "image", scene "image-to-image", options.image (t

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get a job started by generate_3d or generate: its status, progress, credits charged and refunded, and — when it has finished — the result files with their public download URLs, including other formats where the model returned them. Poll about every 5–10 seconds while status is pending or processing;

tools.name: list_job_files
tools.description: List the files a finished job already has, one per format: the main result plus any alternate formats the model returned (for 3D models, for example glb with fbx or usdz), each with a public download URL. Pass format to find one format. This does not convert: if the format asked for is not there, av

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a job that is still pending or processing. This is the same request the web app Cancel button sends: the platform stops the work and refunds the credits of outputs that did not finish, which get_job then shows. Safe to repeat: cancelling a job that is already cancelling or already finished ch

tools.name: start_batch
tools.description: Run the same model, scene and options once for each of several pictures in the account’s Library — for example image to 3D for twelve product photos. Take the scenes and models from list_models (`batches`), and each picture’s asset_id from get_job or search_library on a finished image job. Nothing i

tools.name: list_batches
tools.description: The account’s batches of one scene from the last 24 hours, newest first, with each picture’s progress — and how many pictures its plan lets one batch hold (allowance; 0 means the plan includes no batches).

tools.name: get_batch
tools.description: The state of a batch and of each picture in it: queued, running, done, failed or cancelled, the job_id of its run once started (get_job gives the files), credits charged, and whether retry_batch can run it again.

tools.name: cancel_batch
tools.description: Cancel every picture of a batch that has not started yet; they are never charged and cannot be run again from this batch. Runs already started finish and are charged as usual (cancel_job stops one). Safe to repeat.

tools.name: retry_batch
tools.description: Queue the batch’s failed pictures (and any stopped for want of credits) again as new runs, or only the item_ids given. Charged as each starts, like a new batch of that many pictures: the balance must cover them and they count against a monthly limit.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search the Library of past generations kept by this account, newest first: filter by words in the prompt or title and by kind (3d, image, …). Returns the job id, model, status and result file URLs of each run. Use next_cursor to page. Only runs of this account are ever searched. For the full detail

tools.description: Convert one of the account’s Library 3D models (a GLB) to GLB, STL, 3MF, OBJ or PLY on the server, optionally simplifying it, compressing its geometry, scaling it to a real-world size, moving its origin or repairing it for printing (holes, flipped faces, debris; STL, 3MF, OBJ or PLY), and file the r

tools.name: viewer_job_state
tools.description: Used by the interactive 3D viewer shown next to a generation result, not for direct use: the state of one job and, once it has finished, the URL of the model file the viewer can draw plus the download links. Read-only; the conversation never needs to call it, get_job gives the same facts as text.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_3d, get_job, list_job_files, search_library, viewer_job_state · Private data: get_balance, get_job, list_job_files, get_batch, search_library, convert_model, viewer_job_state · Public sink: generate · Destructive: list_models, generate, list_job_files, start_batch, get_batch, cancel_batch, search_library, convert_model.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_3d, get_job, list_job_files, search_library, viewer_job_state · Private data: get_balance, get_job, list_job_files, get_batch, search_library, convert_model, viewer_job_state · Public sink: generate · Destructive: list_models, generate, list_job_files, start_batch, get_batch, cancel_batch, search_library, convert_model

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
